vim.opt.rtp:prepend(config_root)
vim.g.shoshinvim_config_root = config_root
vim.g.mapleader = " "

local function load(name)
  if vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then return require('user_config.' .. name) end
  local ok, err = pcall(require, 'user_config.' .. name)
  if not ok then
    vim.schedule(function() vim.notify('ShoshinVim: ' .. name .. ' did not load: ' .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) end)
  end
end
load('options')
load('plugins')
load('appearance')
load('navigation')
load('git')
load('diagnostics')
load('lsp')
load('completion')
load('formatting')
load('keymaps')
if not vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then
  local ok, err = pcall(require, 'user_config.user')
  if not ok then vim.notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
end

-- Generated by ShoshinVim. Put manual changes in user.lua.
-- Git change commands; shortcuts call these, so they work with gitsigns or mini.diff.
local function command(name, run, desc) vim.api.nvim_create_user_command(name, run, { desc = desc }) end
command("ShoshinHunkNext", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then if vim.wo.diff then vim.cmd.normal({ ']c', bang = true }) else m.nav_hunk('next') end end
end, "Next Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkPrev", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then if vim.wo.diff then vim.cmd.normal({ '[c', bang = true }) else m.nav_hunk('prev') end end
end, "Previous Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkPreview", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.preview_hunk() end
end, "Preview Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkStage", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.stage_hunk() end
end, "Stage Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkReset", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.reset_hunk() end
end, "Undo Git change")
command("ShoshinBlameLine", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.blame_line({ full = true }) end
end, "Blame this line")
command("ShoshinGitDiff", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.diffthis() end
end, "Diff this file")

-- Generated by ShoshinVim. Put manual changes in user.lua.
-- Search commands. Shortcuts call these, so they work with any finder.
local function command(name, run, desc) vim.api.nvim_create_user_command(name, run, { desc = desc }) end
local function config_root() return vim.g.shoshinvim_config_root or vim.fn.stdpath('config') end
local function with(module, run)
  return function()
    local ok, m = pcall(require, module)
    if not ok then return vim.notify(module .. ' is not installed yet. Open ShoshinVim and download plugins.', vim.log.levels.WARN) end
    local done, err = pcall(run, m) -- For example Git status outside a Git repository.
    if not done then vim.notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
  end
end
command("ShoshinFiles", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.files() end), "Find files")
command("ShoshinGrep", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.grep() end), "Search text in the project")
command("ShoshinGrepWord", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.grep_word() end), "Search the word under the cursor")
command("ShoshinRecent", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.recent() end), "Recent files")
command("ShoshinBuffers", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.buffers() end), "Open buffers")
command("ShoshinDiagnostics", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.diagnostics() end), "Project diagnostics")
command("ShoshinHelpPages", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.help() end), "Search Neovim help")
command("ShoshinKeymaps", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.keymaps() end), "Search keymaps")
command("ShoshinCommands", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.commands() end), "Search commands")
command("ShoshinResume", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.resume() end), "Reopen the last search")
command("ShoshinGitStatus", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.git_status() end), "Changed files (Git)")
command("ShoshinBufferLines", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.lines() end), "Search in this file")
command("ShoshinConfigFiles", with("snacks", function(m) m.picker.files({ cwd = config_root() }) end), "Find Neovim config files")
command("ShoshinExplore", with("snacks", function(m) m.explorer() end), "Project explorer")
command("ShoshinTerminal", function()
  local ok, snacks = pcall(require, 'snacks')
  if ok then snacks.terminal.toggle() else vim.cmd('botright 12split | terminal') end
end, "Terminal")
command("ShoshinBufferDelete", function()
  local ok, snacks = pcall(require, 'snacks')
  if ok then snacks.bufdelete() else vim.cmd.bdelete() end
end, "Close buffer")
